services.name: Unified Fire Authority
services.area: unincorporated county, Millcreek, Holladay, Cottonwood Heights, Taylorsville, Kearns, Magna, Midvale, Herriman, Riverton, Alta, Brighton, Emigration Canyon, White City (and Eagle Mountain in Utah County)
services.evidence: UFA 911 Emergency Transport page: "UFA began providing 911 emergency ambulance services to all communities within UFA jurisdiction July 2009." Also Medicaid Ambulance Assessment 1/12/2026: "UNIFIED FIRE AUTHORITY" 11,867 ground transports (CY2024). Brighton resolution 2025-R-12-2 (12/9/2025) designates UFA for 911 ambulance. Bureau of EMS licence roster: "Unified Fire Authority - Primary license #1867L".

services.name: Gold Cross Ambulance (Salt Lake City)
services.area: Salt Lake City (Salt Lake City Fire Department is a licensed non-transport paramedic rescue, #1804L)
services.evidence: SLCPD release 10/21/2025 (SLC911 call at 500 South 300 West): "Officers from the SLCPD Central Patrol Division, Salt Lake City Fire, and Gold Cross responded and treated 59-year-old Scott Hunt ... Paramedics took Hunt to a local hospital." Utah Legislative Auditor General (2024, le.utah.gov/interim/2024/pdf/00004082.pdf): "Gold Cross is licensed to perform ground transportation and interfacility transfer services within Salt Lake City." Medicaid 1/12/2026: GOLD CROSS AMBULANCE 59,885 ground transports (all Gold Cross licences). Gold Cross press release 5/18/2026: provides "911 services" in Salt Lake County. Bureau of EMS licence roster: "Gold Cross Ambulance Services Inc-Slc - Primary license #1812L".

services.area: whole county (UGRC polygons "Cedar City Ambulance", "Parowan Ambulance", "Beryl Ambulance" are the licence #1110L stations; Beaver 1.4%, Milford Valley 4.0%, Enterprise 1.9% edge slivers)

services.name: Gold Cross Ambulance (Parowan area)
services.evidence: "Multiple agencies responded to the afternoon call of a 39-year-old woman with a likely broken leg on the Valentine Peak Trail east of Parowan" ... "Members of Gold Cross Ambulance also hiked up the trail to assist." ... "she was transferred to a waiting ambulance and transported to Cedar City" (Gephardt Daily, Aug. 26, 2026).

49021.page_note: Gold Cross Ambulance is the only ground-ambulance service licensed in Iron County and serves Cedar City and the Parowan area. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who transports in the Beryl and Escalante Valley area of western Iron County (about 38% of the county).
49021.second_source: stgeorgeutah.com 2026 Gold Cross article (search result) says Gold Cross took control of Iron County 911 in 2015

services.area: Park City and the Snyderville Basin, west county (56.9% of area)
services.evidence: "During Park City Fire’s peak season, when the resorts are open, the district runs five ambulances out of seven stations and sends the closest appropriate unit to the problem." ... "In 1996, the Park City Fire District contracted with Summit County to provide ambulance services to the residents of Park City" (Park Record, Sept. 25, 2026). Medicaid Ambulance Assessment 1/12/2026: "PARK CITY AMBULANCE" 2,564 ground transports (CY2024).

services.name: North Summit Fire District
services.area: Coalville, Henefer, Echo, Upton, Hoytsville, Wanship, north-east county (22.1%)
services.evidence: "North Summit Fire has three ambulances and covers 500 square miles, including Coalville, Henefer, and areas of Echo, Upton, Hoytsville, Wanship, Rockport State Park and everywhere in between. The coverage area is from mile marker 150 on Interstate 80 to the Wyoming border, and from the Morgan County line to just outside of Peoa." (Park Record, Sept. 25, 2026). Medicaid 1/12/2026: "North Summit Fire District" 171 ground transports.

services.name: South Summit Fire Protection District
services.area: Kamas, Francis, Marion, Oakley, Peoa, Woodland and the south-east county (21.0%)
services.evidence: "The South Summit Fire Protection District, which took on its own EMS services two and a half years ago" ... "South Summit Fire covers Kamas, Francis, Marion, Oakley, Peoa, Woodland and other unincorporated areas of Summit County" ... "South Summit Fire also runs a second ambulance 12 hours a day" ... "Park City Fire, South Summit Fire and North Summit Fire are in the top 15%" [of fire departments that provide ambulance services] (Park Record, Sept. 25, 2026). Medicaid 1/12/2026: 257 ground transports.

49043.page_note: Summit County's three fire districts each run their own ambulances: Park City Fire District (Park City and the Snyderville Basin), North Summit Fire District (Coalville, Henefer, Echo, Wanship and the north) and South Summit Fire Protection District (Kamas, Francis, Marion, Oakley, Peoa, Woodland).
49043.second_source: https://medicaid-documents.dhhs.utah.gov/Documents/pdfs/ltc/hcbstransition/Files/2026Q2AmbulanceAssessment.htm (all three listed with 2024 ground transports); UGRC response areas: the three district polygons cover 100% of the county.

services.name: Morgan County Fire Department (Morgan County Ambulance, licence #1501L)
services.evidence: "We are proud to serve the 12,000 residents of Morgan County, covering 611 square miles with fire suppression, technical rescue, and emergency medical services. Our department operates from a centrally located station, responding with a fleet that includes two engines, a ladder truck, two ambulances" ... "We work closely with our partners, including the Morgan County Sheriff’s Office, Utah Highway Patrol, Mountain Green Fire District" (county site, live Oct 2026). Gephardt Daily Oct. 10, 2026 (I-84 crash, Mountain Green Fire responding): "a life threatening injury was transported by Morgan Fire & EMS and Ogden Paramedics."

49029.page_note: Morgan County Fire Department runs the county's ambulances for all of Morgan County, including Mountain Green, whose fire district is a first-response (non-transport) agency.
